verdict.rationale: Trello's own visual boards track task progress, and a community user applied them to a feature-implementation workflow, calling Trello better than Pivotal Tracker except for velocity tracking. The evidence never documents sprint-specific features, so support is only glancing. Missing for 10: sprint/iteration time-boxing, backlog and sprint planning tools, velocity or burndown reporting, first-party agile/sprint documentation.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can plan and manage sprints for agile software development

citations.quote: Track progress of tasks in one convenient place with a visual layout that adds 'ta-da' to your to-do's.
This is exactly what I was looking for a long time for our content generation and feature implementation workflow. Idea board => Doing board => Done board.
I am liking it better than PivotalTracker. Except Pivotal had that whole velocity thing.
